scope: The late operating Lyttelton Gaol around 1903. Includes the Oxford Street entrance and connected frontage, masonry perimeter, cell ranges on two main terraced yards, and subordinate service courts. The separate Warder’s House across Oxford Street, interiors and later Upham clock are outside scope.

review.notes: Qualla was searched first. The only candidate was excluded after its source museum listed copyright as unknown. No alternative imagery was adopted. The courtyard layout and façade use written facts and original mapped site controls.
